The Crawl

every stop, in the order we ate it

STOP1

Village Square Pizza

◉ Upper East Side•May 31, 2026

His · #4Hers · #4

Right on 82nd & Lex, where the whole crawl kicked off. The half-pesto, half-marinara grandma square — crispy fried bottom, big chili-flake energy.

STOP2

Mama's Too

◉ Upper West Side•May 31, 2026

His · #3Hers · #1

Square game absolutely on point — a mushroom white, a hot-chicken number, and a flawless round margherita. The night-cap of day one.

STOP3

Koronet Pizza

◉ A 10-min walk from the Met•June 1, 2026

His · #2Hers · #3

“The jumbo slice since 1981.” I got the regular size... which is still the size of my face. Foldable, cheesy, gloriously oversized.

STOP4

L'Industrie

◉ West Village•June 1, 2026

His · #1Hers · #2

Two slices, both outstanding — a clean classic cheese and the famous burrata, with cold dollops of stracciatella over fresh basil. The burrata sealed the deal.

STOP5

Joe's Pizza

◉ Financial District•June 2, 2026

His · #6Hers · #5

The Greenwich Village institution since 1975. “You saw us in Spider-Man.” A reliable classic — plain, fresh mozz, and white slices.

STOP6

Scarr's Pizza

◉ Lower East Side•June 2, 2026

His · #5Hers · #6

House-milled flour, deeply savory sauce, and a clean classic cheese slice — with a lovely slight char around the edges of the crust.

The Bagels

a pizza crawl needs a bagel crawl — flip the switch

🥟 Bagel Switch
DAY1

Liberty Bagels★ Her #1

🥟 Day 1•May 31, 2026

Day one went bold — a rainbow bagel with strawberry cream cheese, plus our accidental “mess-up” order: a pumpernickel everything with olive and jalapeño cream cheese.

DAY2

Ess-a-Bagel

🥟 Day 2•June 1, 2026

The big guns: a loaded pumpernickel with lox, egg, and avocado, alongside my everything bagel with eggs over avo and olive cream cheese.

DAY3

Apollo Bagels★ His #1

🥟 Day 3•June 2, 2026

A naturally-leavened everything bagel done two ways — half scallion cream cheese, half cultured butter & jam. Blistered, caramelized crust and all.

Eaten & ranked — his & hers — all over Manhattan ❤ Summer 2026
